Financing for Furnace Installation

Furnaces are an essential part of keeping your home warm during colder months. With our financing options, you can spread the cost of installation over time while enjoying the immediate comfort of a new system. Here’s what you can expect:

Electric Furnace

  • Benefits: Affordable and environmentally friendly, electric furnaces are easy to maintain and can last up to 30 years! While their operating costs may be higher due to electricity rates, their long lifespan and lower maintenance needs make them a popular option.
  • Ideal For: Homes with access to affordable electricity.

Natural Gas Furnace

  • Benefits: Known for their energy efficiency and consistent heat output, natural gas furnaces offer long-term savings on energy costs.
  • Ideal For: Homes in colder climates with access to natural gas.

Oil Furnace

  • Benefits: Durable and capable of generating heat quickly, oil furnaces are suitable for homes in areas without access to natural gas. However, they come with higher operating costs and require proper ventilation to ensure safety.
  • Ideal For: Homes without natural gas lines that need powerful heating capabilities.

Financing for Heat Pump Installation

Heat pumps offer a versatile, energy-efficient alternative to traditional furnaces. While they have a higher upfront cost, their long-term savings and eco-friendly operation make them an excellent investment. Our financing options make it easy to upgrade to the latest in heating technology.

Ductless Mini-Split Heat Pump

  • Benefits: Perfect for homes without ductwork, these highly energy-efficient units offer zone-specific heating and cooling to reduce energy bills.
  • Ideal For: Homes seeking ductless heating and cooling solutions.

Dual Fuel or Hybrid Heat Pump

  • Benefits: These systems switch between gas and electric heating, optimizing efficiency based on outdoor temperatures for cost savings over time.
  • Ideal For: Homeowners looking for energy efficiency and flexibility in fluctuating climates.

Gas-Fired Heat Pump

  • Benefits: A robust heating solution for larger homes, gas-fired units offer dependable performance but may not be as energy-efficient as hybrid systems.
  • Ideal For: Larger homes or commercial buildings over 4,000 square feet.

Air-Source Heat Pump

  • Benefits: These systems extract heat from outdoor air and are highly efficient, offering significant savings on energy bills. However, their performance may be limited in extremely cold climates.
  • Ideal For: Moderate climates with homeowners looking to reduce energy costs.

Geothermal Heat Pump

  • Benefits: One of the most energy-efficient and environmentally friendly systems available, geothermal units provide substantial long-term savings with minimal maintenance.
  • Ideal For: Eco-conscious homeowners seeking the ultimate in efficiency and longevity.
